thumbnails.prompt_en: Epic cinematic high-saturation HDR three-panel composition, triumphant mood. On the left, a cold desaturated Stockholm suburb at night behind blue-and-white police tape with flashing blue lights, a small plain Swedish national flag (blue with yellow Nordic cross) in the top-left corner. In the center, an anonymous attractive Swedish detective in his 50s with a likeable face, chest-up and filling most of the frame height, awestruck and jaw-dropped, looking toward the right side. On the right, larger and closer to the camera in a heroic low-angle shot, a bright Korean police station gun vault with hunting shotguns standing in perfect numbered rows, bathed in golden backlight with glowing rim light and lens flare, and a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waving proudly in sunlight in the top-right corner, taking up at least a quarter of the frame height.

On the left, a cold grey dawn scene of a Swedish suburban house front damaged by a blast with police lights in the distance, desaturated, a small plain Swedish national flag in the top-left corner. In the center, an anonymous attractive European news reporter in his 40s with a likeable face, chest-up, awestruck and looking toward the right side. thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high-saturation HDR close-up. A single hunting shotgun with a numbered tag and a small GPS tracking device attached, locked in a steel rack inside a Korean police station gun vault, fills more than half of the frame. Beside it stands an anonymous confident proud Korean police officer in his 50s with a warm likeable face, chest-up, arms crossed, under warm golden rim light. A small Korean flag patch on the officer's sleeve; clean, bright, trustworthy atmosphere, the shotgun dramatically large and sharp.

thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high-saturation HDR close-up at a Korean customs inspection area. An opened wooden furniture crate reveals a hunting shotgun hidden inside the furniture panel, filling more than half of the frame and lit by the glow of an X-ray scanner screen. Beside it, an anonymous attractive Korean customs officer in her 40s with a likeable face in uniform, chest-up, wide-eyed with surprise as she points at the hidden gun. A small Korean flag on the wall in the background; sharp, bright, investigative mood.
